{{Top|leg}}
'''Votomo''' was an individual who was a subscriber to, and commenter on, [[Cynabar's Droid Datalog]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]], Votomo noted that its inexpensive and innocuous nature made it very easy to upgrade into a combat or espionage unit.<ref name="CDD">{{JournalCite|14|Cynabar's Droid Datalog (article series)}}</ref>
